goal: Generate a 2×2 four-panel comic telling a rhythmic and twisty workplace skit.

story.theme: Monday battle report meeting: the data is beautiful, but no one dares to ask that question
story.main_character: The presenter in the conference room, short hair, dark blue suit, serious expression, resembling Tim Cook as a recognizable prototype (Q version exaggerated, not a realistic portrait).

style.art_style: American cartoon + bold outline + flat color
style.consistency: In 4 panels, the main character is the same person, with a unified style
style.color_palette: Apple white + space gray + bright green data highlights

items.label: Start
items.scene: A steep curve rises on a large screen, the main character points to the chart, audience silhouettes nodding.

items.label: 承
items.scene: The main character flips to the next page, with a cloud of keywords 'Ecological Synergy' filling the screen.

items.label: Turn
items.scene: colleague in the corner secretly checking their phone, WeChat work group notices 'tonight's iteration'
items.dialogue: The boss did not speak in the group

items.label: Combine
items.scene: After the meeting, the main character looks out the window alone, the coffee has cooled.

dialogue_design.balloon_style: White background with sharp corner business bubbles.
dialogue_design.font_style: Bold small text in bold font

must_keep: The main character in 4 panels is the same person
Clear beginning, development, transition, and conclusion
WeChat Interface Only as a Prop Small Image, Not Obscuring the Main Narrative
Irony is mild and does not attack personally
avoid: Each grid has more than one line of dialogue exceeding 12 characters
Collage of real human face photos
